sql:
SELECT t.industry AS industry,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dla.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN o.user_id END) AS members_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dla.user_id IS NULL THEN o.user_id END) AS nonmembers_count,
  ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN dla.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN o.id END)::numeric
        / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dla.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN o.user_id END), 0), 2) AS avg_orders_per_member,
  ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN dla.user_id IS NULL THEN o.id END)::numeric
        / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dla.user_id IS NULL THEN o.user_id END), 0), 2) AS avg_orders_per_nonmember,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN dla.user_id IS NOT NULL
                 THEN o.grand_total / (CASE WHEN o.currency_code = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE er.rate END)
            END), 0) AS avg_order_value_member_eur,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN dla.user_id IS NULL
                 THEN o.grand_total / (CASE WHEN o.currency_code = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE er.rate END)
            END), 0) AS avg_order_value_nonmember_eur
FROM orders o
JOIN tenants t ON t.id = o.tenant_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id, user_id FROM loyalty_accounts) dla
  ON dla.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND dla.user_id = o.user_id
LEFT JOIN exchange_rates er
  ON er.base_code = 'EUR' AND er.quote_code = o.currency_code AND er.as_of = CAST(o.placed_at AS DATE)
WHERE o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
  AND t.industry IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT t2.industry
    FROM tenants t2
    JOIN loyalty_programs lp ON lp.tenant_id = t2.id
    WHERE lp.is_active = true
  )
GROUP BY t.industry
ORDER BY t.industry
note: Membership is defined as any loyalty_accounts row for that user+tenant (deduplicated so multi-program enrollees aren't double-counted), independent of whether that specific program is active; industry eligibility is still restricted to industries with at least one tenant having an active loyalty_programs row. EUR conversion uses exchange_rates as of the order's placed_at date, with EUR orders treated as rate 1.
